final: WITH filtered_records AS (SELECT ID, HGB, APTT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE UA >= 3.9), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) as avg_diff FROM filtered_records GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) as overall_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) as overall_avg_diff FROM patient_averages    -- Returns the overall averages across all patients: HGB average and APTT-PT average from records with UA ≥ 3.9
